stories.title: AI data center developers begin suing local jurisdictions behind bans and moratoriums — claims range from officials exceeding authority to violations of due process and equal protection laws

sources.title: AI data center developers begin suing local jurisdictions behind bans and moratoriums — claims range from officials exceeding authority to violations of due process and equal protection laws
sources.title_en: AI data center developers begin suing local jurisdictions behind bans and moratoriums — claims range from officials exceeding authority to violations of due process and equal protection laws
sources.title_original: AI data center developers begin suing local jurisdictions behind bans and moratoriums — claims range from officials exceeding authority to violations of due process and equal protection laws
sources.summary: Some data center developers are suing local governments for passing temporary bans and moratorium, saying that they such moves violated their rights to due process and equal protection. This move has gotten one county to reverse their decision, while others are still fighting the cases in court.
sources.summary_zh: 一些数据中心开发商正在起诉地方政府通过临时禁令和暂停令，称他们的此类举动侵犯了他们享有正当程序和平等保护的权利。这一举措使得一个县改变了决定，而其他县仍在法庭上审理案件。

stories.title: Nvidia doubles RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell's MSRP to a staggering $16,000 — 96GB card started pre-orders below $8,000 last year

sources.title: Nvidia doubles RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell's MSRP to a staggering $16,000 — 96GB card started pre-orders below $8,000 last year
sources.title_en: Nvidia doubles RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell's MSRP to a staggering $16,000 — 96GB card started pre-orders below $8,000 last year
sources.title_original: Nvidia doubles RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell's MSRP to a staggering $16,000 — 96GB card started pre-orders below $8,000 last year
sources.summary: A data center GPU has become more expensive because of the AI boom enabled by unprecedented data center buildouts — shocking. Nvidia's RTX 6000 Pro Blackwell is now twice as costly as it was last year at the time of its launch, and 20% more expensive than even a couple of months ago.
sources.summary_zh: 由于前所未有的数据中心扩建所带来的人工智能热潮，数据中心 GPU 变得更加昂贵——令人震惊。 Nvidia 的 RTX 6000 Pro Blackwell 现在的价格是去年推出时的两倍，甚至比几个月前还要贵 20%。

stories.title: Samsung Foundry updates process roadmap to move 1.4nm node to 2029 — high-NA EUV will enable 1nm-class and smaller nodes in 2030 and beyond

sources.title: Samsung Foundry updates process roadmap to move 1.4nm node to 2029 — high-NA EUV will enable 1nm-class and smaller nodes in 2030 and beyond
sources.title_en: Samsung Foundry updates process roadmap to move 1.4nm node to 2029 — high-NA EUV will enable 1nm-class and smaller nodes in 2030 and beyond
sources.title_original: Samsung Foundry updates process roadmap to move 1.4nm node to 2029 — high-NA EUV will enable 1nm-class and smaller nodes in 2030 and beyond
sources.summary: Samsung Foundry has delayed its 1.4nm-class node to 2029, making SF2 one of its longest-lasting process technologies ever. The company also aims to start using High-NA EUV for its 1nm-class process technology in 2030.
sources.summary_zh: 三星代工已将其 1.4 纳米级节点推迟到 2029 年，这使得 SF2 成为其历史上最持久的工艺技术之一。该公司还计划在 2030 年开始在其 1 纳米级工艺技术中使用高数值孔径 EUV。

primary_item.summary: Samsung Foundry has delayed its 1.4nm-class node to 2029, making SF2 one of its longest-lasting process technologies ever. The company also aims to start using High-NA EUV for its 1nm-class process technology in 2030.
primary_item.summary_zh: 三星代工已将其 1.4 纳米级节点推迟到 2029 年，这使得 SF2 成为其历史上最持久的工艺技术之一。该公司还计划在 2030 年开始在其 1 纳米级工艺技术中使用高数值孔径 EUV。
